{{Quote|I've gotta shipment of holographic ''Hutt-smut'' that absolutely, positively ''must'' be delivered overnight to the ''Kurluvion'' system. They just ''love'' Hutt-smut there, can't get enough.|A Snivvian|<ref name="Tales14">{{Tales|14|Smuggler's Blues}}</ref>}}
The '''Kurluvion system''' was located in the [[Weneen sector/Legends|Weneen sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" />

{{Talesstart}}
In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date">"[[Smuggler's Blues]]" takes place concurrently with the portion of {{Film|IV}} that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> a [[Unidentified Snivvian (Chalmun's Cantina)|Snivvian]] approached the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] in [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's Cantina]]<ref name="Tales14" /> in the [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] [[City/Legends|settlement]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], in the Outer Rim's [[Arkanis sector/Legends|Arkanis sector]].<ref name="TEA" /> Claiming that the inhabitants of the Kurluvion [[Star system/Legends|system]] loved consuming [[Holoporn|holographic pornography]] of the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]]<ref name="Tales14" /> [[Species/Legends|species]],<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] attempted to hire Solo's services in transporting a shipment of such material that the former needed delivered to the system [[Standard day/Legends|overnight]]. Solo, however, refused the job offer, claiming the smuggling of Hutt holoporn conflicted with<ref name="Tales14" /> his<ref name="TEA" /> integrity.<ref name="Tales14" />
{{Talesend}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SmugglersBlues.jpg|thumb|right|300px|The Kurluvion system was first mentioned in the comic story "Smuggler's Blues."]]
The Kurluvion system was first mentioned in "[[Smuggler's Blues]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] story written by the [[Fillbach Brothers]] and included in the [[Star Wars Tales 14|fourteenth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' comic book series by [[Dark Horse Comics]],<ref name="Tales14" /> published on [[December 11]], [[2002]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/53992/star_wars_tales_1999_14|text=Star Wars Tales (1999) 14}}</ref> Plausible stories in the [[Star Wars Tales 1|first]] through [[Star Wars Tales 20|twentieth issue]] of ''Star Wars Tales'' were deemed [[Canon|S-canon]] until referenced in a non-''Tales'' source, at which point the subject matter was elevated to C-canon status.<ref name="SWB">{{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=752#14952461|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2006-06-04|time=3:05 AM}}</ref> The first C-canon mention of the [[Star/Legends|star]] system itself came with the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square N-6.<ref name="TEA" />
